description.en: Explore how the five daily prayer times correspond to solar elevation and atmospheric depression angles.

Beginner.en: Learn that Fajr starts at dawn, Dhuhr at solar noon, Asr in late afternoon, Maghrib at sunset, and Isha at nightfall.

Intermediate.en: Understand solar depression angles: Fajr (-18° or -15°), Isha (-17° or -18°), and Shadow length ratio for Asr (1x or 2x).

Advanced.en: Study high-latitude approximations (Nearest Latitude, Middle of Night, Seventh of Night) when twilight persists all night.

description.en: Understand synodic lunation cycles, conjunctions, Danjon limits, and crescent visibility criteria.

Beginner.en: Learn how the moon changes shape every 29.5 days and why the Hijri year is 11 days shorter than the solar year.

Intermediate.en: Understand astronomical new moon (conjunction) vs hilal crescent visibility.

Advanced.en: Study Yallop ($q$-parameter), Odeh ($V$-parameter), and Bruin visibility contrast equations.
